excluded.ai_exports_custody_copy: already equal to its primary on the 4 TB container (path and size dry run, four providers); it is the deliberate off-disk replica, so a second copy beside the primary adds nothing
excluded.ciphertext_replica_restore_payloads: about 41.7 GB of unpacked restore-test plaintext on the T7 only; derived from ciphertext tarballs whose names and sizes match their primaries, so it is regenerable and was left in place

method: rsync -rltp into a new directory (no --delete, no overwrite), then sha256 of every file on both sides compared
other_trees_verification: path and size only (rsync --size-only dry run), not content hashes: every other T7 tree already exists on the 4 TB container apart from timestamp and Finder-metadata differences
subject: custody-t7-unique-consolidation
t7_retention: keep: Archive4T, Ingress, Scratch and TM-Mac share one physical drive, so the T7 is the only independent physical copy
verification: sha256 manifest of every copied file compared byte for byte against the source; private item list and manifest live beside the copy on the destination volume
volume_identity_note: BSD disk numbers are reassigned across mounts: the 20261018 sibling receipt records the T7 as disk9, while on 20261021 the same volume is container disk7 on physical disk6; identify devices by volume name, not diskN
